answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that vests over a long horizon: one identity is cheap, but thousands means locking capital in every one, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught double-signing or spamming. Reputation accrues only through completed, paid work, so a fresh island of sock-puppet accounts starts with zero trust and cannot vote or earn until it has a costly history. Forging an ivory-tower set of aged, staked agents costs more than any single payout is worth, so sybil farming turns unprofitable.
